decision: Prioritize one factorized system-versus-rest readout on existing features. Retain complementary heads as the second representation hypothesis only if another feature experiment is warranted. Neither route is launched or scientifically validated by this memo.

evidence.fact: Original head discovery used only132 true1024 fit documents,101 statistics-fit/31 discovery; it macro-averaged full/tail AUROC. It did not select heads for mixed short/multi/public-natural domains.
Eight selected heads are concentrated in layers7/15/31; five of eight are from layer7. This is concentration, not proof of redundant information.
Published long-source augmentation maximin min24=.8530928 versus matched=.9005534 and oldhead=.8977865; multiple old/full-tail guards failed. More long rows alone did not solve this trial.
Published4seed mean reached min24=.9016260 but failed full/tail guard. Variance reduction and threshold calibration alone did not satisfy the full criterion.

Deterministic fit-only head/role/half samples showed standardized RMS ratios .9778..1.0393 and coordinate-mean-shift RMS<=.07825 old sigma for matched long profiles. No gross scale mismatch was found; this is neither a population support test nor a causal account of the failures.

Independently audited natural-fit new-max33 min33=.902407 versus fixed4seed ensemble=.901626; old-natural five-class accuracy .902253 to .834058 and CoT recall .795722 to .640534, while assistant recall .998882 to .999721. This establishes forgetting in non-system classification but aggregate recall alone does not identify every confusion destination.

The same CSV gives old-tail system F1 .930327 for new versus .935328 for calibrated oldhead, while public-natural-all system F1 is1.0 and public CoT/tool truth is absent. PublicSUA success cannot establish preserved legacy CoT performance.

methods.name: Specialized binary system head with exactly frozen non-system conditional distribution

definitions.base: Use unchanged oldhead27a22... and original fit-only512 scaler. z_old is the frozen five-class raw logit vector for the same token.
definitions.system: a_old=z_old[0]-logsumexp(z_old[1:]); delta(x)=4*tanh(g_phi(x)); r_phi=sigmoid(a_old+delta). g_phi is one fixed512->32 GELU->1 MLP with final weights/bias zero.
definitions.output: p_new(system)=r_phi; p_new(k)=(1-r_phi)*q_old(k). This is algebraically the frozen old5 logits with delta added only to the system logit.
definitions.inputs: Only the current token head512 vector; a_old/q_old are outputs of the frozen base. No neighbors, sequence index, true role, wrapper, source, family or body-position label is an inference input.

methods.precise_preservation: For every pair of non-system classes j,k, p_new(j)/p_new(k)=q_old(j)/q_old(k)=exp(z_old[j]-z_old[k]); their ranking is exactly preserved. Therefore a token whose old non-system winner was CoT cannot newly switch to assistant within the non-system branch. This is a structural guarantee, not a measured improvement.
methods.five_class_limit: Full argmax may still switch between system and the fixed best non-system class: system wins iff r_phi >= (1-r_phi)*max(q_old). A CoT token can still become system, and an old system token can become another role. Overall five-class accuracy/CoT recall therefore still require guards; freezing q alone does not guarantee them.
methods.tail_limit: Thresholded system P/R/F1/BAcc depend only on r_phi and global tau. Freezing q cannot repair a poor long-tail binary boundary. A diagnostic splice using the current new model r and old q would exactly retain that new model system metrics and its tail F1 regressions; it is not a qualifying solution. No such splice or probability evaluation was run.
methods.why_not_plain_threshold_or_resampling: Delta is token-feature-dependent while a threshold is a single global shift. All non-system discrimination is fixed; publicSUA cannot rewrite CoT-versus-assistant weights. Repeating rows or changing a five-class threshold does not impose this constraint.

minimal_candidate_protocol.candidates: Exactly one binary residual architecture/objective, with new and same-role matched arms. No linear/MLP/bound/anchor/seed search.
minimal_candidate_protocol.data: Exact old578090 plus clean-natural63403 slots, or exact same63403 frozen role-matched old draws. Preserve255fit/64public roots,32fit/16validation wording families and dependency components; no source reranking or new IDs.
minimal_candidate_protocol.loss: Unweighted binary BCE for system versus rest, using all old CoT/tool negatives and all native S/U/A natural fit. With q fixed, five-class CE differs from this BCE by -log(q_old[y]) for non-system truth, a constant with respect to phi. No new class-specific loss weight is needed.
minimal_candidate_protocol.initialization: Old base frozen; zero final delta layer makes initial full five-way probabilities exactly oldhead for every token. Same private epoch shuffle/seed20261021 and identical binary target at every matched slot.
minimal_candidate_protocol.budget: Same641493 instances/157updates per epoch,last2517,max45,min10,patience8,improve1e-5; report realized best/total updates rather than claim equal total updates. Early-stop only unchanged old5 mean-systemF1; freeze best/history/GPUold proof before newC4/public predictions.
minimal_candidate_protocol.calibration: One global tau using the unchanged effective-F32 fullgrid/min33/FPR9 rule. No test-derived threshold, no conditional tau and no per-source inference rule.
minimal_candidate_protocol.anchor_boundary: For the first minimal protocol, use BCE only plus the frozen base/bound, rather than add an unsearched KL coefficient. If a later anchored variant is justified, it must be another predeclared experiment; do not add it after viewing this candidate validation.

methods.distillation_alternative_not_an_extra_ca: A trainable non-system branch with KL(q_old||q_new) on old non-system fit is a softer dual-task alternative, especially if real new CoT/tool supervision becomes available. Finite KL permits changes in ordering and cannot guarantee CoT preservation; publicSUA-only data provide no new CoT/tool targets. Hard freezing q is the smaller and clearer first experiment.

resources.GPUs: One A40 per arm; at most2 concurrent readout workers after other jobs finish. No LM model load.
resources.precompute: CPU stream existing rawF16 banks in4096-row chunks through the frozen original embedded scaler/readout; save shared5 F32 raw logits bound to model/source/features/rows/sample_ix/range hashes. No8640 bank upload, no new decode or generation. Reuse outputs for both arms.

methods.success: Only the new arm can advance. Require absolute min33>=.90 and strict improvement over its role-matched arm, calibrated oldhead and fixed4seed ensemble, while passing unchanged old4F1/accuracy,old5mean,old/new full/tail nonregression,publicSUA,FPR9 and mandatory savedGPU originalhead guards. Additionally publish old-natural CoT/user/assistant argmax recalls and full confusion; public absent CoT/tool remainN/A. A developer win still requires wholly fresh disjoint C4 and natural confirmation.
risks: The binary boundary may still trade precision for recall or regress tailF1; the proposal does not solve that mathematically.
The8 frozen heads may not contain enough relevant signal; the residual has less adaptable capacity than the already-trained full MLP.
Bound4 can multiply system odds by at most exp(4); basePsys=.05 reaches only about.742 at its upper limit.
Repeated use of the same developer groups is model development, not independent evidence.

methods.name: Fit-only mixed-domain complementary heads; preserve the original8 and append only2
methods.hypothesis: The long-only head-discovery criterion may have missed heads carrying short-dialogue/source-format system signal complementary to the selected8. New feature information, rather than resampling or a different threshold, could reduce the tradeoff.
methods.fixed_scope: Keep frozen MXFP4, normal native tags, original8 rank order, current source identities and old banks. A later protocol may scan all2304 heads but admit exactly2 additions, giving640 dimensions. No new user/reply/source IDs are needed for this diagnostic.
methods.fit_only_split: Before LM use, split only original C4 fit documents and clean natural fit sources into statistics/discovery by fixed hash of whole source/dependency components. Keep all five role views and original sparse/full overlaps of a C4 source in one partition. Keep each natural system family and assistant-repeat component in one partition. All old/new-C4/public validation sources stay excluded from head selection. Never use profile/role/position/source labels as inference inputs.
methods.selection: Fit per-head shrinkage LDA on statistics-only rows with fixed domain/role-balanced caps. Stream actual discovery probabilities, not moments-as-accuracy. Cap discovery at20000 sampled content rows. Greedily append2 heads reducing worst-domain document-macro binary system logloss of a fixed per-head-probability mean of the current selected set; deterministic tail-AUROC/head-ID tie break. Domains cover short-single, multi, true1024 full/tail and clean public-natural FIT. This proxy is a fit-development selection criterion, not an unbiased accuracy estimate or evidence the future joint MLP will improve.
methods.new_extraction: A first bounded scan, for example at most1.0M already-prepared serialized input tokens after frozen metadata-only selection, accumulates current-layer sampled moments immediately. Do not retain full36-layer sequences. After selection, re-forward only the exact rows needed for future training/development to save the2 added heads in a separate128-dim F16 bank with original sample_ix/cache mapping. Compose features by row identity with the retained old512 bank; do not rewrite/delete old banks.

resources.LM: Exactly4 sharded A40, original native MXFP4; same sequential bounded hooks and disabled-write hidden-state selfcheck.
resources.row_scope: old densefit578090 + oldval173032 + newC4val61440 + natural fit/val80116. No failed-augmentation327680 fit rows need re-extraction for this fixed training scope.
resources.time_estimate: Parent reference3.339M tokens/~40min implies about12min LM-forward floor for a1M-token fit-only scan, plus all-head statistics cost. Re-extracting needed rows from old+newC4val+natural banks needs roughly3.9M serialized tokens/~47min at that throughput. Obtain exact metadata length sums and free-memory guards before execution; these are not measured guarantees.
resources.memory_note: Moment exports, LDA factorization, gathered activations and ranking workspaces exceed persistent sizes. Host probability scratch need not occupy root disk or /dev/shm. Preserve a declared reserve; do not delete existing caches.

methods.control: Use one frozen original8-head baseline under the identical original/natural fit rows, seed, early-stop rule, threshold grid and update budget. Appending2 changes both feature information and model capacity; report that confound. No random-head or architectural search is authorized by this proposal.
methods.success: One predeclared joint readout and one global threshold must improve the same developer min33 over its fixed8-head control while passing all existing old5/public/full-tail/FPR/savedGPU guards. An absolute90% developer floor remains necessary. Any apparent win still requires wholly fresh disjoint C4 and natural confirmation.
risks: Scanning2304 possibilities can overfit fit-discovery; it remains developer material.
Original8 were already chosen in prior development; adding2 cannot be claimed as an unbiased head-importance estimate.
Extra heads may be correlated or irrelevant, and a joint MLP may not exploit the LDA proxy.
If no2-head discovery improvement exists, stop before the costly full-bank re-extraction.

source_diversity_note: Real source diversity remains relevant, but the completed natural-fit result shows sourceSUA addition alone can erase legacy CoT discrimination. Do not select new sources based on current failures; adding more publicSUA without preserving the conditional non-system task is not the priority. New public replies would still not be120B generation or evidence of system-instruction following.
execution_preference: First freeze and test the single factorized binary residual with matched control on existing banks; no automatic launch is authorized. Use a complementary-head scan only as a separate later representation experiment if warranted. Do not expand configurations during either result review.
not_done: No probabilities or model weights read/recomputed.
No source/body filtering, source ID choice, new feature extraction, training or test scan.
No guarantee that frozen conditionals meet full accuracy or tailF1 guards.
